title: Preventive Maintenance Agreements — Multiple Where the Owner Called Out Demand Service
content:
## Portfolio ruling

A multiple is applied to the credit owed on a Preventive Maintenance Agreements record where the owner has had to call out a demand service technician at their own cost while the agreement was running. The reading is of the owner's demand service calls under the Demand Service Rate Programs that were completed in the last six months.

### The ladder

- Where **2 or more** demand service calls of the owner were completed in the last 6 months, the credit is taken at the repeat call multiple, **1.5**, of the figure reached so far.
- Where **exactly 1** such call was completed in the last 6 months, the credit is taken at the single call multiple, **1.25**, of the figure reached so far.
- Where **no** such call was completed in the last 6 months, the credit is taken as computed, with no multiple applied.

A call counts when the day it was completed falls inside the last 6 months.

### Cases (hypothetical figures)

| Demand service calls of the owner completed in the last 6 months | Figure reached so far | Figure after the multiple |
|---|---|---|
| 4 | 700.00 USD | 1 050.00 USD |
| 2 | 700.00 USD | 1 050.00 USD |
| 1 | 700.00 USD | 875.00 USD |
| none | 700.00 USD | 700.00 USD |

The multiple is read from the owner's Demand Service Rate Programs call records, not from the maintenance agreement's own visit history.
